## Reference videos

- [Bayesian Statistics: Credible vs Confidence Intervals](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YPceDssQFWo) — Academia Elevated, English. **watch first**. Watch how a Bayesian credible interval differs from a frequentist confidence interval, exactly the part of the lab that reports a posterior interval.
- [31 - Normal prior conjugate to normal likelihood - proof 1](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MUhsT0U_nxY) — Ox educ, English. Watch a Normal prior conjugate to a Normal likelihood; it supports the lab's normal-conjugacy section.
- [(ML 6.1) Maximum a posteriori (MAP) estimation](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kkhdIriddSI) — mathematicalmonk, English. Watch MAP estimation as a point taken from the posterior; use it for the point-estimation part, which does not replace the whole distribution.
